title: Quantum Chips Just Jumped From 5 Qubits To Over A Thousand
hook: This number just broke every chart.
closing: Data's still waiting for his quantum laptop.
question: Trust a quantum computer with your passwords?

segments.say: IBM's newest quantum chip now holds 1,121 qubits.
Every extra qubit doubles what's representable -- just 20 of them already pass a million possible states at once.
IBM's quantum chip now holds far more qubits than Google's newest one.
